The Hero Xtreme 160R 4V gets a major update for 2026, with revised styling and a host of new features, including a TFT screen, three riding modes, ride-by-wire throttle, and cruise control. We ride the top-spec Carbon variant to see how these updates improve the package and whether it delivers on the road.
Cameraperson: Ashish Raj
Editor: Deven Bhalla
